style_notes: Late delivery penalty: write the delivery date, the grace period and the penalty percentage with its maximum in three separate, neighbouring sentences of one clause.
Agreed unit price: state the price in one sentence and, in a separate sentence of the same clause, say that the price is fixed for the term of the agreement and can only change by written amendment.
extra_decoys: The Buyer may reject non-conforming Equipment by written notice within fifteen (15) days of delivery.
